data.content:
Vanoro is a five-star luxury hotel, built in the heart of the beautiful and historic city of Thessaloniki. Vanoro offers modern rooms and suites for tourists and travelers from local, regional, national, and international businesses.
Vanoro trusted us with the identity and branding from its birth. We were together at every step along their journey.
Anza is Vanoro’s exclusive restaurant that offers impressive dishes of Mediterranean cuisine.
We were asked to create a beautiful and unique logo to attract attention immediately after the launch.
We designed this logo with special features in the font used and with a distinct symmetry that creates sensitivity and a beautiful image.
Our agency created the logo and all accompanying branding materials, down to the animated invitations for the grand opening.

We created a friendly spirit with all our designs, with light brown chosen ad brand’s identity colour, which symbolizes reliability and security, as an accompanying characteristic of hotel’s brand promise.
